uds.text: Rayne is appointed chancellor of the Tolarian Academy by Urza, who hopes to push her and her husband Barrin into producing an offspring, and Hanna is born in 4181 as the last known individual born of the project.
She argues with Urza, urging him to start thinking like a father, and tells him she has found more promising students than he and her husband combined.
When Urza drops off a Phyrexian negator corpse for dissection, Rayne and Barrin find a Capashen blood sample the negator took, revealing that a big attack on Benalia is imminent.
